install.title: Install Edge extension
install.intro: No terminal commands needed. LoginDeck prepares the extension and local connection component; you finish installation in Edge.
install.preparing: Setting up the local connection and extension files…
install.prepared: Ready. The local component is configured. Load the extension in Edge next.
install.notPrepared: Installation files are not ready yet.
install.edgeStep: Open Edge below, enable Developer mode at the lower left, and click Load unpacked.
install.folderStep: Click Show extension folder. Finder selects edge-extension. Choose this folder in the Edge folder picker.
install.pathTip: Cannot find it? Copy the path above, press Command + Shift + G in the Edge folder picker, paste the path, press Enter, and select the folder.
install.developerAlt: Enable Developer mode in Edge (Chinese UI)
install.finishStep: Keep LoginDeck running, pin the extension to the Edge toolbar and select Check connection. After connecting, submit a website login form to see the save prompt. Once you confirm, LoginDeck adds the account or updates its password.
install.updateTip: Already installed? After preparing files again, click Reload for LoginDeck in Edge. If the old extension was loaded from the source project, load the stable folder above instead.
install.failed: Setup or opening failed. Retry; if it persists, check that your user directory is writable.
install.conflict: A different registration or unfinished installation exists. It was not overwritten. Ask the maintainer to check it before retrying.
install.missing: Installation resources are missing. Use a complete LoginDeck app bundle.
install.edgeMissing: Could not open Microsoft Edge. Install Edge or enter edge://extensions in its address bar manually.
